instruction: A cinematic action still captured in a medium full shot shows an indoor gym with metal training rigs and a hazy atmosphere. On the left, the man in the patterned black t-shirt (R4) faces right, throwing a left-hand strike forward. On the right, the man in the plain black t-shirt (R2) stands defensively, facing left and raising both forearms to block the blow. The man in the patterned black t-shirt (R4) executes the strike while the man in the plain black t-shirt (R2) successfully absorbs the impact. The scene is illuminated by cool, hazy lighting with a soft background glow and desaturated tones.
